rules.question: Does a selection change scroll the list, and how far?
rules.decision: plan 2026-10-14-column-shares-scroll-left-align.md, Change 2, the user's answers 4 and 5

owner_lines.why: scroll_last_row: the one ImGui call that moves a list to its selected row

rules.note: Every click once centred the clicked row, so the list crept and the next click at the same spot landed on another song. selection_scroll decides from why the selection changed (SelectionSource) and scroll_last_row applies it. A list that scrolls itself any other way is a second answer. The scope is src because a GUI test sets the scroll position by hand to set up its case.
